title: PDF to DOCX & Markdown Converter
description: Converts the text layer of a PDF into a Markdown file and a DOCX file: font-size heading tiers, paragraphs, bulleted and numbered lists, and best-effort tables read in geometric (y,x) order rather than raw content-stream order. Detects and reports pages with no text layer instead of producing silent empty output. Entirely client-side, zero network calls, pdf.js inlined workerless.

pdf_file.description: A text-layer PDF file, chosen or dropped in the browser

mcp_tool_definition.name: convert_pdf_to_docx_markdown
mcp_tool_definition.description: Extracts the text layer of a PDF and converts it to Markdown and DOCX, with font-size-based heading detection, bullet/ordinal list detection, and best-effort geometric tables. Reports pages with no text layer rather than returning silent empty output. Browser-based, client-side only, zero network calls, zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/643-pdf-to-docx-markdown-converter.html for interactive use.
